stages.name: initial

response.explanation: The model omits the interrupt delivery opportunities at enabled STEP boundaries and after the foreground call, so it does not preserve the execution profile. Its callback and payload assignments are otherwise consistent with the source under the stated configuration.

issues.problem: There is no representation of interrupt delivery at the next enabled STEP boundary or after the foreground call. In particular, while the foreground update is in progress, the ISR can run after STEP 0 restores interrupts at STEP 3; the model simply assigns enabled from k and ends.
issues.suggested_correction: Represent the profile's bounded pending-IRQ behavior at each applicable enabled STEP boundary and after foreground completion, invoking the ISR when a pending request is delivered. Keep STEP bodies indivisible and respect the one-request bound.
